item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows a ladder leaning from the ground to a wall, forming a right triangle.

Before writing an $a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2}$ equation, what must Diya identify?

options.A: The ground distance and the wall height as the two legs, and the ladder as the hypotenuse opposite the right angle.
options.B: Perpendicular distances as the answer label on the diagram.
options.C: Write $a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2}$ first; checking that the lengths form a right triangle can wait.
options.D: Form the equation for any three lengths nearby, even if they do not make a right triangle.
